تستعطن (form VIII)

# تُسْتَعَطْنَ (tustaʕaṭna) /tus.ta.ʕatˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعَطَ (istaʕaṭa)
